owner_decision.statement: The Owner decided on 2026-10-09 to release 1.5.6. Stable 1.5.5 is published for all 44 fixed-group packages: authenticated registry census on 2026-10-09 observed latest 1.5.5 and rc 1.5.0-rc.2 after the v1.5.5 publication from main 1a03a9156b6e6429fb2a84964b95e514a2da2cb8 with scorecard observation SC-20261009T155331-001. Four changesets pending on origin/main (the @stynx-nyx/angular openStatus option, @stynx-nyx/outbox named destinations, @stynx-nyx/signature trust-profile sets and the @stynx-nyx/offline-sync 1.5.6 slice; DETRAN requests UPS-NGSSE-13, UPS-OBX-11, UPS-SIG-07 and UPS-OFS-10/11/12/14 under ADR-DEVAI-ADOPTION-0016) advance the fixed group from 1.5.5 to 1.5.6 under scripts/version-packages.mjs. Publish only with the latest dist-tag and an action-specific exact-main-SHA Owner receipt; preflight latest must remain 1.5.5 and rc must remain 1.5.0-rc.2 until publication. This decision does not authorize angular-profile 2.0.0 remediation.

anomalies.rationale: The Owner adjudicated 2.0.0 as an incorrect major assignment rather than a canonical STYNX 2.x decision.
anomalies.closure_condition: Unified stable 1.5.6 is verified for all 44 publishable packages, latest resolves to 1.5.6, rc remains at 1.5.0-rc.2, and angular-profile 2.0.0 remains immutable non-canonical history.
